title: Cambridge IELTS 18 Academic Speaking Test 3 (Online Test)

parts.title: Part 1 — Introduction and interview
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask general questions about yourself and a few familiar topics. Answer naturally and try to extend each answer with a reason or example. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: How often do you buy things online? [Why?]
What was the last thing you bought online?
Do you ever see things in shops and then buy them online? [Why/Why not?]
Do you think the popularity of online shopping is changing your town or city centre? [Why/Why not?]

parts.title: Part 2 — Individual long turn
parts.instructions: You will be given a topic card. You have one minute to prepare and may make notes. Then speak for one to two minutes. Try to keep talking until the examiner stops you.
parts.cue_card_topic: Describe a time when you enjoyed visiting a member of your family in their home.
cue_card_bullets: who you visited and where they lived
and explain what you enjoyed about this visit

parts.title: Part 3 — Two-way discussion
parts.instructions: The examiner will ask further questions connected to the Part 2 topic. These are more abstract and require you to explain, compare, and speculate. Try to give extended, well-reasoned answers. This part lasts 4–5 minutes.

questions.question: When do families celebrate together in your country?
How often do all the generations in a family come together in your country?
Why is it that some people might not enjoy attending family occasions?
Do you think it is a good thing for parents to help their children with schoolwork?
How important do you think it is for families to eat together at least once a day?
Do you believe that everyone in a family should share household tasks?
